text.autoconfig.heartstealer.title: HeartStealer Settings
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.init: Max health when a player enters the world (1.0 = half a heart)
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.atta: Attack bonus gained per kill (applies to base attack and held weapons)
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.keep: Keep all gained max health and attack bonus after death
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.maxH: The maximum max-health allowed. Default 1000000 = effectively unlimited (bypasses vanilla 1024). Host config wins in multiplayer
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.incl: Off by default: PvP kills give no bonus. Enable to grant rewards based on the killed player's max health
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.pvpD: Off by default: ranged/thrown damage against other players stays vanilla (no attack bonus). Enable to also add bonus against players. Mob damage always gets the bonus. Note: melee uses the vanilla attribute, so it still applies against players
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.boss: Multiplier for max health gained from bosses (1.0 = full, 0.5 = half)
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.enti: Entity IDs that never trigger rewards, e.g. minecraft:armor_stand
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.cust: On = draw our own red bar + armor bar. If colorfulhearts is installed, its rendering takes over automatically and we only show the bonus text. Off = fully disable our health bar rendering (vanilla hearts show as normal)
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.heal: DNF = multi-layer colors; NUMERIC = numeric compensation
text.autoconfig.heartstealer.option.maxH: How many color layers to draw (1 layer = 3 rows); overflow shown as +N
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.heartstea: Start with half a heart, steal life and power from every kill!
